title: pleurophora squarrosa
intro: Pleurophora squarrosa, commonly known as the "Brazilian mint," is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its calming effects and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Pleurophora squarrosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
